subject: Inspect native bundled Codex exec invocation flags
body: Read-only discover the actual native bundled Codex CLI exec flags and installed EGM plugin. Do not run a model.

argv:
set +e
CLI="$HOME/.codex/plugins/.plugin-appserver/codex-cli/bin/codex"
printf '--- CODEX EXEC HELP ---\n'
"$CLI" exec --help 2>&1
printf '\n--- CODEX PLUGIN LIST ---\n'
"$CLI" plugin list 2>&1
printf '\n--- CLI VERSION ---\n'
"$CLI" --version 2>&1
printf 'CLI_HELP_COMPLETE\n'
